public_rationale: The original February paper supports both parts. AlphaGeometry2 solved 84% of its formalized IMO geometry benchmark, while its language excluded substantial classes of problems. Those documented limits support the ordinary reading that strong benchmark performance coexisted with broad gaps in geometry coverage.
limitations: The benchmark used formalized geometry tasks; the result is not an end-to-end score on the complete IMO examination.
The results and coverage limits are reported by the system's developers.
This assessment does not validate every separate example in Marcus's post or predict the difficulty of extending the system.
